goal: In the live animals and high-risk plants import notification journeys, Save and continue always goes on to the next page of the journey that applies, ending at the review page, whether the page was reached from a new notification, Overview, a reopened draft, a copy, a new session, a review page Change link or an amendment. Back on every journey page goes to wherever the trader came from, except after a return from the Import Notification Service address book, where it goes to Overview. Back on the review page follows the trail where one exists; after a cancelled amendment it goes to the dashboard, and with no trail (the declaration, the confirmation page, a typed address, a new session) it goes to Overview on a draft or amendment and to the dashboard once submitted. Pages being amended show the same buttons and links as on a draft, with no button straight back to the review page. The review page's buttons and Continue, the declaration and the confirmation page stay as they are. The opening run and its return-to-Overview routing are removed as if they had never existed.
reposWhy: The routing lives in each frontend's own journey platform code (shared/kit.js, flow/*) and its set's journey pages: the live animals frontend and the high-risk plants frontend. The tests repo holds both journeys' E2E suites. The behaviour spec is in this workspace's openspec/, which the build loop keeps current on every row.
